references.text: Israel shall dwell safely by itself, as a separate people, reflecting the same theme of Israel's unique position among the nations.
Moses' blessing over Joseph mentions that he shall live apart from his brothers, a similar motif of separation and distinctiveness.
Israel is called to be a chosen people, a holy nation, set apart from all other peoples on earth.
God has separated Israel from the nations so that they may be His own people, a holy people set apart from other nations.
The Lord set boundaries for the peoples and took Israel as His own inheritance, showing Israel's unique standing among the nations.
Haman describes the Jews as a people who live apart from all others with their own laws, an echo of Balaam's prophecy.
Christ has made the two one and broken down the dividing wall, but this shows how Israel was originally separated from the Gentiles.
The psalmist looks upon Israel from the mountains and heights, in connection with the elevated position from which Balaam saw the people.
